label: Marine Life
description: Ocean subjects, surface and submerged — underwater-tagged items pair naturally with location/underwater.

items.name: humpback-breach
items.text: a humpback whale breaching three-quarters clear of the sea, pleated throat and barnacled pectoral fins twisting before the fall

items.name: orca-pod
items.text: an orca pod surfacing in staggered formation, one tall straight bull dorsal among curved female fins, blows hanging backlit

items.name: great-white
items.text: a great white shark on slow patrol, countershaded to vanish from above and below, pilot fish holding station at its flank

items.name: octopus
items.text: an octopus flowing across the reef mid-color-change, chromatophore waves of rust and white, skin papillae spiking to match the coral

items.name: sea-turtle
items.text: a green sea turtle banking through cathedral light shafts, front flippers flying in slow wingbeats, two remoras riding its shell

items.name: manta-ray
items.text: a manta ray barrel-rolling through a plankton cloud, cephalic fins unfurled into feeding scoops, white belly flashing on each loop

items.name: sardine-baitball
items.text: a sardine baitball collapsing into a mirrored sphere as gannets pierce it in bubble trails and a sailfish flickers below

items.name: seahorse
items.text: a seahorse anchored to a seagrass blade by its coiled prehensile tail, eyes swiveling independently, dorsal fin a transparent blur

items.name: jellyfish-bloom
items.text: a moon jellyfish bloom drifting like slow lanterns, the four-leaf-clover ring glowing through each translucent bell

items.name: seal-play
items.text: a young harbor seal spiraling around the camera, blowing a silver stream of bubbles, whiskers flared with curiosity

items.name: clownfish
items.text: a clownfish nestled deep in anemone tendrils, mucus-armored against the stings it lives inside, one white bar showing

items.name: dolphin-bowride
items.text: dolphins bow-riding the pressure wave, surfing without a single tailbeat, backs slicing crystalline water

items.name: sperm-whale-rest
items.text: a family of sperm whales sleeping vertically like standing stones, noses up in the featureless blue, motionless together

items.name: hammerhead-school
items.text: scalloped hammerheads schooling in their hundreds overhead, layered silhouettes wheeling slowly around a seamount

items.name: cuttlefish-display
items.text: a cuttlefish hovering on its rippling skirt fin, hypnotic bands of dark and light pulsing down its body as the feeding arms take aim

items.name: whale-shark
items.text: a whale shark hanging vertically to gulp a spawn cloud at the surface, white-spotted checkerboard flanks fading into the deep

items.name: penguins-porpoising
items.text: a line of penguins porpoising at full speed, clearing the water in low synchronized arcs, bubble trails stitching the surface

items.name: nudibranch
items.text: a jewel-bright nudibranch grazing across an orange sponge, gill plume fanned, warning colors advertising its stolen toxins

items.name: leafy-seadragon
items.text: a leafy seadragon drifting among kelp fronds, every appendage grown into a trailing leaf-shaped lobe, only the blur of two tiny transparent fins betraying that it swims rather than drifts

items.name: mantis-shrimp
items.text: a peacock mantis shrimp squared up at its burrow mouth in full carnival color, raptorial clubs cocked to strike, stalked eyes ranging independently

items.name: coral-spawning
items.text: a reef spawning in synchrony nights after the full moon, pink egg bundles lifting off every coral head at once like snowfall in reverse

items.name: anglerfish
items.text: a deep-sea anglerfish hanging in absolute blackness, its bacterial lure the only point of light, needle teeth ajar, fin rays spread to feel for pressure waves
